text:
elaine: Heads up — opened a docs PR to fix request metadata header casing and the curl/python sample mismatch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

samir: Thanks — is this the curl vs python mismatch where curl uses `X-Request-Meta` and python uses `request_metadata`?

elaine: Yep. Also OpenAPI currently lists `requestMetadata` in the GenerateOptions schema while examples send it as a header. My PR standardizes on the header `X-Request-Metadata` (kebab-case) and updates SDK snippets to show `request_metadata` mapping to the header.

morgan: Quick Q: does the runtime expect `X-Request-Metadata` or `x-request-metadata`? Headers are case-insensitive but we should pick a canonical form for the docs.

aaron: Runtime treats headers case-insensitive; infra prefers the canonical `X-Request-Metadata`. +1 to use that exact casing in examples.

samir: Can you also add a comment in the OpenAPI parameter so codegen doesn't keep treating it as a query/body param?

elaine: Good catch. PR moves `requestMetadata` out of the body schema into a header parameter under components/parameters and adds `x-sdk-alias: request_metadata` so Python/Ruby/Go SDKs map cleanly.

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1234 — examples page updated.

morgan: Spotted one more: JS SDK snippet still sends `requestMetadata` in the request body. Can we update `examples/js` too?

elaine: Updated JS + Python examples and added a short migration note: "Previously some clients passed request metadata in the body or query. Use header `X-Request-Metadata` instead. SDKs accept `request_metadata` option which is translated to the header."

samir: Looks good. Can we get CI green and then merge?

aaron: Confirmed — telemetry/logging already read `X-Request-Metadata` so no infra changes required.

morgan: I'll follow up to adjust integration tests that assert the header presence.

elaine: Thanks all — merging once green. :shipit:

---

Example snippets updated in the PR:

Curl (docs example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-Metadata: user:1234;trace:abcd" \
  -d '{"input":"summarize this"}'
```

Python (docs / SDK snippet):
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
client.generate(
    model="redwood-1",
    input="summarize this",
    request_metadata="user:1234;trace:abcd"
)
```

Migration note (short):
- If your integration previously set `requestMetadata` in the request body or query, switch to sending `X-Request-Metadata` as a header. SDKs will handle the header translation if you pass the language-specific `request_metadata` option.

Reviewer checklist left in PR description:
- [ ] Update OpenAPI components/parameters (done)
- [ ] Update JS/Python examples (done)
- [ ] Add migration blurb to the generate endpoint docs (done)
- [ ] Run codegen to validate SDK param aliasing (pending CI)
- [ ] Update integration tests to assert header (morgan)

If anyone sees other sample mismatches on the generate page lmk and I can sweep them in this PR.
__notes: Slack thread: short back-and-forth, lightweight coordination for docs PR about header casing and sample fixes
